title: TrafficAssessment
description: Output schema for Module 1 (Traffic Intelligence) evaluating API traffic risk and legitimacy.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this assessment event.

trace_id.description: Distributed tracing identifier associated with the request or evaluation window.

contract_version.description: Semantic version of this JSON Schema contract.

service_version.description: Version of the Traffic Intelligence service that produced this assessment.

model_version.description: Identifier/version of the traffic scoring model (e.g. traffic-v0, traffic-xgb-v1).

window_seconds.description: Observation time window duration in seconds.

total_rps.description: Observed total requests per second during window.

suspicious_rps_estimate.description: Estimated suspicious or anomalous requests per second.

risk_score.description: Assessed security risk probability score between 0.0 and 1.0.

legitimacy_score.description: Assessed traffic legitimacy score between 0.0 and 1.0.

top_signals.description: Key behavioral or anomaly signals detected.
